examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: to see someone out, to see off
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'водить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'I will walk out / escort', paired with 'провожать'.

examples.text: Проводите его, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Please see him out.

examples.text: Я тебя провожу.
examples.trans: I'll see you off.

examples.text: Держи свои духи. Давай я тебя провожу. Пока!
examples.trans: Here is your perfume. Let me walk you out. Bye!
